name: FILX LinearVesting unguarded init
summary: The FILX LinearVesting implementation's init(token, periods, interval) has no initializer guard and sets owner to the caller, so it can be re-run after deployment. The attacker re-initialised the vesting proxy to become owner and used withdraw() to take all of its FILX, which it sold for USDT.
notes: FILX (a DN404 token) has no DefiLlama price; valued at the 169,577.74 USDT the attacker realised selling it in the same transaction (rule 15).

The deployer initialised the proxy at creation; the only other FILX outflows before the exploit are beneficiary vesting releases, and the anchor emptied the proxy, so there is no earlier exploit or campaign.
